description: 无障碍硬规则（WCAG 取向）。低置信不阻塞但 risky。

rules.expr: icon-only interactive component must have ariaLabel
every form field has an accessible label (label or ariaLabel)
text on background meets WCAG AA contrast (≥4.5:1 body, ≥3:1 large)
rules.note: v1 由 token 对保证；contrast 数值校验留作扩展

rules.expr: status not conveyed by color alone (use tag text + icon, not only color)
interactive components preserve visible focus ring (token focus.ring)
